description: Source code for the 'fieldmeta' package in the 'kyaml' library, defining metadata structures and methods for handling field comments, references, and schema validation in Kubernetes YAML processing.

classes.name: FieldMeta
classes.description: Contains metadata attached to YAML fields, including schema and extensions.

classes.name: XKustomize
classes.description: Holds custom extension data for kustomize, such as setBy and partial setters.

classes.name: PartialFieldSetter
classes.description: Defines how to set part of a field, e.g., image tag.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the FieldMeta's schema is empty.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads metadata from a YAML node's comments.

methods.name: processShortHand
methods.description: Parses shorthand references in comments to load schemas.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes metadata back to a YAML node.

methods.name: WriteV1Setters
methods.description: Writes setter definitions in v1 format.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a string value against the field type.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Returns the YAML tag for the field type.

methods.name: TagForValue
methods.description: Returns the YAML tag for a specific value.
